basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old tech enthusiast living in Bendigo, Australia. I have a keen interest in gaming, particularly anything related to Valve and Gaben. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy reading sci-fi, especially the 'Expeditionary Force' series. I'm currently working as a systems analyst for a local IT firm. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the local countryside or visiting new cafes. I'm usually online during the evenings, after 6 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in the IT sector for over 10 years. I stay updated with tech trends and enjoy troubleshooting hardware and software issues. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-teaching through online courses and tech forums.
